# Targeting & Offer Optimization

::: {.hero-lead}
A predictive targeting project for a B2B software upsell campaign, built to improve customer selection and campaign profit.
:::

::: {.metrics-grid}
::: {.detail-card}
### Objective
Choose the most valuable customers for targeted outreach.
:::

::: {.detail-card}
### Methods
Compared logistic regression, neural networks, and XGBoost for response prediction.
:::

::: {.detail-card}
### Outcome
Identified a roughly 30% targeting threshold that maximized expected campaign profit.
:::
:::
:::

:::{.section-row}
<div class="section-label">Overview</div>

The project linked predictive accuracy to business value by using profit rather than response rate alone to define the best targeting rule.
:::
